lessons.title: 1. First Variable & String Value
lessons.description: Welcome to Python! In Python, you store text in variables using the equals sign (`=`). Assign the string "Python" to a variable named `language`.
learning_objectives: Create a variable and assign a string literal using =
lessons.starter_code:
# TODO: Create a variable named `language` and set it to "Python".
language = None

tests.name: test_language_variable
tests.unittest_code:
def test_language_variable(self):
    self.assertEqual(language, "Python", msg="Expected variable 'language' to equal 'Python'.")

exercises.question: Which symbol is used to assign values to variables in Python?

lessons.title: 2. Numbers & Reassignment
lessons.description: Variables can also hold numbers. You can update a variable's value or add numbers together. Set `apples` to 5, then set `total_fruit` to `apples` + 3.
learning_objectives: Assign integer values to variables and calculate totals with +
lessons.starter_code:
# TODO: Create `apples` set to 5.
apples = None

# TODO: Create `total_fruit` set to apples + 3.
total_fruit = None

tests.name: test_apples_variable
tests.unittest_code:
def test_apples_variable(self):
    self.assertEqual(apples, 5, msg="Expected apples to equal 5.")

tests.name: test_total_fruit_variable
tests.unittest_code:
def test_total_fruit_variable(self):
    self.assertEqual(total_fruit, 8, msg="Expected total_fruit to equal 8.")

lessons.title: 4. Cinema Ticket Billing (Practice)
lessons.description: Apply variables to calculate the total cost for movie tickets and snacks.
learning_objectives: Calculate multi-item bill totals using variables
lessons.starter_code:
ticket_price = 12
popcorn_price = 8
num_tickets = 3

# TODO: Calculate ticket_total = ticket_price * num_tickets
ticket_total = None

# TODO: Calculate grand_total = ticket_total + popcorn_price
grand_total = None

tests.name: test_ticket_total
tests.unittest_code:
def test_ticket_total(self):
    self.assertEqual(ticket_total, 36, msg="ticket_total should equal 36.")

tests.name: test_grand_total
tests.unittest_code:
def test_grand_total(self):
    self.assertEqual(grand_total, 44, msg="grand_total should equal 44.")
